eyebrow: Before a metric goes on the deck

steps.label: Is it a trend, not a snapshot?
steps.sub: a single number has no context without 3-4 periods behind it

steps.label: Does it map to a risk the board owns?
steps.sub: financial, regulatory, reputational, operational — not team workload

steps.label: Does it point to a decision?
steps.sub: approve budget, accept a risk, escalate a vendor, or confirm no action needed

code:
ENGINEER METRIC              ->  BOARD METRIC
alerts triaged / month        ->  % reduction in critical unpatched systems (90-day trend)
vulnerabilities found         ->  % of internet-facing critical vulns remediated within SLA
firewall rules changed        ->  % of critical vendors with a current security assessment
